title: Fix VSCode Launch Configs
summary: Fixed incorrect VSCode launch.json and tasks.json configs: fixed semio-repo/vscode dev task from npm type with wrong path js/vscode to shell npx nx dev semio-repo; fixed nx project refs for semio/logo (@semio/logo, root at semio/assets/logo), semio/icons (@semio/icons, root at semio/assets/icons), semio/net (@semio/net, root at semio/net/Semio); removed non-existent semio/grasshopper and semio/yak projects; added missing semio/sketchpad (build, preflight, dev, publish) configs.
prompt: Fix incorrect VSCode launch.json and tasks.json configs: wrong semio-repo/vscode dev task type/path, wrong nx project paths for semio/logo (assets/logo), semio/icons (assets/icons), semio/net (net/Semio), remove non-existent grasshopper/yak projects, add missing semio/sketchpad.
